wins: Identified open 80/tcp and 443/tcp, enabling web enumeration focus.
Captured web server fingerprinting data and retried credential stuffing attempts through recorded responses.
fails: Persistent failure to pivot from initial web server; lateral movement attempts timed out due to missing credentials.
Zero success in container escape despite repeated exploit script execution.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon was solid but lacked follow-through on exploitation and post-exploitation; more targeted pivoting and credential capture needed.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated brute-force attempts against /admin login without modifying wordlist or handling account lockouts, leading to repeated delays.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 responds with HTTP 200 and CMS fingerprinted
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster and nikto scans to enumerate directories and vulnerabilities

skill_cards.if_condition: When default web admin form detected with POST action
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted Burp Intruder attack adjusting payload positions and throttle

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial exploitation results in valid shell and sudo privileges present
skill_cards.then_action: Collect /etc/passwd, sudoers, and inspect cron jobs for credential reuse opportunities

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in quickly mapping web assets during reconnaissance

next_experiments.title: Multi-vector web pivot
next_experiments.description: After web creds obtained, attempt SSH pivot through captured admin account and verify access to internal hosts.

next_experiments.title: Credential validation automation
next_experiments.description: Automate credential fuzzing with Burp Intruder plus rate-limit controls to avoid lockouts before pivot attempts.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation enumeration
next_experiments.description: Leverage discovered shell to enumerate sudo rights and scheduled tasks for potential lateral scripts.
